description: PK (1/2) — Driving: UNION ALL STG_FCT_CLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY + STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY. Mã hồ sơ tín dụng CLOS hoặc RLOS
etl_logic: SELECT STG_FCT_CLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_CLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME AND (STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.DECISION_CODE IN ('Submit','Send To PostSanction','Submit To DisbursementMaker','Send To HOSupport','Reject') OR STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('CancelRevoke','CancelPermanent'))) UNION ALL SELECT STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME AND (STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.DECISION_CODE IN ('Submit','Send To PostSanction','Submit To DisbursementMaker','Send To HOSupport','Reject') OR STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('CancelRevoke','CancelPermanent')))
note: Grain 1 dòng/hồ sơ (không theo DAYID, khác bảng cũ FCT_PDTD_KPI_APPLICATION). review 2026-09-18: chỉ nhận hồ sơ đã đến quyết định cuối/đã hủy — hồ sơ đang xử lý dở dang không xuất hiện trong bảng này

note: Mặc định -1. Nhánh RLOS lấy STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.APPLICATION_SK trong cùng UNION ALL của dòng WI_NAME

Mặc định -1. Nhánh RLOS lấy STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.ORG_UNIT_SK trong cùng UNION ALL của dòng WI_NAME

description: Ngày xử lý của hồ sơ — mốc để AGG_LOS_KPI_YTD_DAILY xếp hồ sơ vào đúng DAYID khi SUM/COUNT lên grain ngày
note: Nhánh RLOS lấy STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.PROCESSED_DATE trong cùng UNION ALL của dòng WI_NAME

description: Mức độ hoàn thành hồ sơ, thang 0-1
etl_logic: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('CreditApproval','CreditCommittee') AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.DECISION_CODE IN ('Submit','Send To PostSanction','Submit To DisbursementMaker','Send To HOSupport','Reject')) THEN 1.0 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('CreditApproval','CreditCommittee')) THEN 0.8 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE = 'UnderwriterChecker') THEN 0.6 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE = 'UnderwriterMaker') THEN 0.5 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE = 'DetailDataEntry') THEN 0.2 ELSE NULL END
note: Nhánh RLOS dùng cùng công thức trên STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT. Tính từ toàn bộ lịch sử hồ sơ trên bảng WORKSTEP_EVENT tương ứng hệ (không phải chỉ dòng snapshot hiện tại). Thứ tự CASE WHEN ưu tiên từ cao xuống thấp — mỗi EXISTS chỉ cần kiểm tra bước cao nhất chưa được match ở nhánh trên

description: Điểm KPI — cam kết SLA nhập liệu tập trung + cam kết SLA phê duyệt tín dụng
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'RLOS' THEN NVL((SELECT REF_SLA_NLTT.SLA_DE_TOTAL_RESULT FROM REF_SLA_NLTT JOIN DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT ON DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.PRODUCT_SK WHERE REF_SLA_NLTT.PRODUCT_LINE = DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_LINE_NAME AND REF_SLA_NLTT.SYSTEM_CODE = 'RLOS'),0) + NVL((SELECT DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.SLA_CREDIT_OFFICER FROM DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION WHERE DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK),0) + NVL((SELECT DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.SLA_CREDIT_APPROVER FROM DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION WHERE DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK),0) WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'CLOS' THEN NVL((SELECT REF_SLA_NLTT.SLA_DE_TOTAL_RESULT FROM REF_SLA_NLTT JOIN DIM_CLOS_PRODUCT ON DIM_CLOS_PRODUCT.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.PRODUCT_SK JOIN DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION ON DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK WHERE REF_SLA_NLTT.PRODUCT_LINE = DIM_CLOS_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_LINE_NAME AND (REF_SLA_NLTT.SUB_PRODUCT IS NULL OR REF_SLA_NLTT.SUB_PRODUCT = DIM_CLOS_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_NAME) AND REF_SLA_NLTT.NEW_CHANGE_REQUEST = DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.CHANGE_REQUEST AND REF_SLA_NLTT.SYSTEM_CODE = 'CLOS'),0) + CASE WHEN (SELECT DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.APP_GRP FROM DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION WHERE DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK) = 'C1' THEN 4 + 4 ELSE NVL((SELECT DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.SLA_CREDIT_OFFICER FROM DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION WHERE DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK),0) + NVL((SELECT DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.SLA_CREDIT_APPROVER FROM DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION WHERE DIM_CLOS_APPLICATION.DIMENSION_KEY = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK),0) END END
note: review 2026-09-21: SLA_DE_TOTAL_RESULT là report-time lookup (không denormalize vào DIM), SLA_CREDIT_OFFICER/SLA_CREDIT_APPROVER vẫn đọc từ DIM_RLOS/CLOS_APPLICATION (đã tính sẵn ở đó qua RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN/CLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHDN/TDKHDNL). Hồ sơ CLOS APP_GRP='C1': SLA_CREDIT_OFFICER + SLA_CREDIT_APPROVER dùng hằng số cứng 4 giờ mỗi vai trò thay vì lookup DIM (xem 2.4.7)

etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.VOLUME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.POINT * 8 / AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.VOLUME END
note: review 2026-09-17: sửa lại đúng chiều phép tính theo SRS BC9 (bản cũ ghi nhầm POINT/8*VOLUME, sai lệch 64 lần). Là đầu vào duy nhất của QUY_DOI_RLOS_DAY/QUY_DOI_CLOS_DAY ở AGG_LOS_KPI_YTD_DAILY

description: Tổng thời gian xử lý của hồ sơ, đơn vị giờ
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'RLOS' THEN (SELECT SUM(get_business_minute(STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.ENTRYDATE, STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.EXITDATE))/60 FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('DetailDataEntry','DataInputerChecker','UnderwriterMaker','UnderwriterChecker','CreditApproval') AND STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.BI_FLAG_APPROVAL = 'First Approval') WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'CLOS' THEN (SELECT SUM(get_business_minute(STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.ENTRYDATE, STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.EXITDATE))/60 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WORKSTEP_CODE IN ('DetailDataEntry','DataInputerChecker','UnderwriterMaker','UnderwriterChecker','CreditApproval','CreditCommittee') AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.BI_FLAG_APPROVAL = 'First Approval') END
note: review 2026-09-17: bổ sung điều kiện BI_FLAG_APPROVAL='First Approval' — loại trừ thời gian vòng làm lại (rework) sau lần EXIT đầu tiên khỏi CreditApproval/CreditCommittee. Công thức khớp 100% điều kiện đã dùng tính BI_FLAG_APPROVAL cho BC5. CLOS cộng thêm CreditCommittee so với RLOS

description: Hồ sơ có từ 2 tài sản bảo đảm trở lên (RLOS-only, NULL nhánh CLOS)
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE <> 'RLOS' THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL.DAYID = (SELECT MAX(STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL_2.DAYID) FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL_2 WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL_2.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_RLOS_COLLATERAL.WI_NAME)) END
note: review 2026-09-17: RLOS-only (SRS chỉ định nghĩa trong khối Nguồn RLOS); dùng COUNT(*) thô trên dòng đã lọc DAYID mới nhất (không phải COUNT DISTINCT — nguồn full-snapshot-mỗi-ngày); áp dụng ngưỡng >=2 theo ý nghĩa nghiệp vụ SRS (Cách lấy dữ liệu ghi nhầm literal =2)

description: Hồ sơ có từ 3 nguồn thu trở lên (RLOS-only, NULL nhánh CLOS)
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE <> 'RLOS' THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.SALARYFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.CARFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.HOUSEFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.ENTERPRISSEFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.DIVINGFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.FAIMILYFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.NONLICFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WAGESFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.PENSIONFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.OTHERFLAG = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME) END
note: SRS không định nghĩa cho CLOS

description: Hồ sơ có nguồn thu từ kinh doanh, không áp dụng SeAPro/SeALand (RLOS-only, NULL nhánh CLOS)
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE <> 'RLOS' THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN (UPPER(NG_SB_RLOS_EXTTABLE.PRODUCT_NAME) NOT LIKE '%SEAPRO%' AND UPPER(NG_SB_RLOS_EXTTABLE.PRODUCT_NAME) NOT LIKE '%SEALAND%') AND (NVL(STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.FAIMILYFLAG,'No') = 'Yes' OR NVL(STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.ENTERPRISSEFLAG,'No') = 'Yes' OR NVL(STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.NONLICFLAG,'No') = 'Yes') THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY JOIN NG_SB_RLOS_EXTTABLE ON NG_SB_RLOS_EXTTABLE.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME) END

description: Hồ sơ có đúng 2 ngoại lệ
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'RLOS' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.DAYID = (SELECT MAX(STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2.DAYID) FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2 WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME)) WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'CLOS' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.DAYID = (SELECT MAX(STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2.DAYID) FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2 WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME)) END
note: review 2026-09-17: COUNT(*) thô trên dòng đã lọc DAYID mới nhất (không phải COUNT DISTINCT DEVIATION_BK — nguồn full-snapshot-mỗi-ngày, DEVIATION_BK loại trừ cột REASON khỏi hash)

description: Hồ sơ có từ 3 ngoại lệ trở lên
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'RLOS' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.DAYID = (SELECT MAX(STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2.DAYID) FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2 WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION_2.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_RLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME)) WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'CLOS' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.DAYID = (SELECT MAX(STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2.DAYID) FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2 WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION_2.WI_NAME = STG_FCT_CLOS_DEVIATION.WI_NAME)) END
note: Cùng cách lọc DAYID mới nhất + COUNT(*) như DEVIATION_G2

description: 'Y' nếu hồ sơ có tồn tại (bất kỳ dòng lịch sử nào) USERNAME thuộc 2 tài khoản test/kỹ thuật
etl_logic: CASE WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'RLOS' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_RLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.USERNAME IN ('hanh.nh2','hai.bt2')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHEN AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.DATASOURCE = 'CLOS' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT WHERE STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.WI_NAME = AGG_LOS_KPI_APPLICATION.WI_NAME AND STG_FCT_CLOS_WORKSTEP_EVENT.USERNAME IN ('hanh.nh2','hai.bt2')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END
note: EXISTS trên toàn bộ lịch sử hồ sơ (không chỉ sự kiện hoàn tất gần nhất). AGG_LOS_KPI_YTD_DAILY loại các hồ sơ IS_TEST_ACCOUNT='Y' khỏi MỌI phép COUNT/SUM _DAY

description: Cột generic của WFINSTRUMENTTABLE (CLOS-only, RLOS luôn NULL)
note: Dùng làm điều kiện lọc IS NOT NULL riêng cho SLHS_CLOS_DAY/SLGN_CLOS_DAY tại AGG_LOS_KPI_YTD_DAILY — KHÔNG áp dụng cho TAT_CLOS_DAY/QUY_DOI_CLOS_DAY. Nhánh RLOS luôn NULL (STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY không có cột này)
